advancements.spice_road.pumpkin_purist.d: Feast on a pumpkin pie seasoned with cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger and cloves

commands.spice_road.locate.spice.not_fou: Could not find a %1$s region within reasonable distance

spice_road.configuration.compat.sneakToP: Whether placing a food item carrying a Spice Profile override as a block that isn't a Block Entity (e.g. a Farmer's Delight-style placeable food) requires sneaking, so it isn't silently voided by an accidental right-click. Disable to place such items without sneaking, like vanilla.
spice_road.configuration.compat.tooltip: Behavior around other mods' placeable food items.
spice_road.configuration.cooking.tooltip: How cooking alters the flavor an ingredient passes on.
spice_road.configuration.cooking.varianc: Upper bound of the per-flavor multipliers applied to inherited flavor when cooking.
Lower bound of the per-flavor multipliers applied to inherited flavor when cooking. The same ingredients always cook into the same flavor.
spice_road.configuration.cultivation.aqu: Whether flowing water passes through Spices that grow in water, like Wasabi, as if they weren't there. Disable if another mod that changes how fluids flow conflicts with it - flowing water then can't enter these plants, and planting one into flowing water turns that spot into a water source. Plants that still hold flowing water when this is disabled get washed away.
Whether Spices that grow in water, like Wasabi, stop growing while they aren't waterlogged. They can still be planted and kept on dry ground either way.
spice_road.configuration.cultivation.gro: Growth-speed multiplier for common Spice Plants.
Growth-speed multiplier for epic Spice Plants.
Growth-speed multiplier for rare Spice Plants.
Per-tier growth pacing of planted Spices, applied on top of vanilla's farmland and light based growth odds. 1.0 matches vanilla speed.
Growth-speed multiplier for uncommon Spice Plants.
spice_road.configuration.cultivation.har: Harvest difficulty (1-5) at or below which a Spice counts as hardy, and can be planted anywhere the ground allows regardless of its Spice Region.
spice_road.configuration.cultivation.reg: Whether planting a Spice's seeds requires the Spice Region at that spot to actually support that Spice. Hardy Spices are always exempt.
spice_road.configuration.cultivation.too: Where Spices can be planted, and how quickly they grow.
spice_road.configuration.file.client.too: Client-only display options, never shared with a server.
spice_road.configuration.file.server.too: Values the world runs on. On a server these are set by the host.
spice_road.configuration.flavor.minimumA: Any flavor that isn't zero counts as at least this strong for effects and tooltips.
Strength each flavor approaches when stacking many spices, giving diminishing returns. Stored values are never capped.
spice_road.configuration.flavor.sufficie: Strength a flavor must reach, in either direction, to count as sufficiently seasoned for checks like advancements. Independent of the flavor soft cap.
spice_road.configuration.flavor.tooltip: How the Spices on a food item turn into the flavor you actually taste.
spice_road.configuration.plant.harvestYi: Harvest yield multiplier for Spices that grow on the ground, applied when picking a mature plant by hand. Breaking a plant instead rolls its loot table, which bakes in this option's default value when the mod is built, so changing it here does not affect break drops.
Harvest yield multiplier for Spices that grow on the ground, applied when picking a mature plant by hand.
spice_road.configuration.plant.tooltip: Harvesting Spices that grow on the ground.
spice_road.configuration.region.cellScal: Approximate edge length of a Spice Region, in blocks. Larger regions mean longer journeys between Spices, which suits multiplayer servers.
spice_road.configuration.region.clusteri: How strongly Spice Region generation favors common Spices over rarer ones.
spice_road.configuration.region.salt.too: Salt mixed into the world seed when resolving Spice Regions. Change this to any random value to shuffle which Spice grows where.
spice_road.configuration.region.salt.war: This affects existing worlds! Changing it reshuffles every Spice Region, including in already generated chunks.
spice_road.configuration.region.tooltip: Size, layout and identity of the Spice Regions that decide which Spice grows where.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMap.lootEn: Whether Spice Maps can generate as chest loot.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMap.search: Maximum distance, in Spice Regions, searched for a Spice Region's heart by /locate spice, /locate spice_climate, and by Spice Map chest loot.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMap.toolti: Finding Spice Regions, and the maps that point to them.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMap.trades: Base emerald price of a Spice Map trade, multiplied by the Spice's tier multiplier. The final price is capped at 128; above 64, the compass is replaced by a second stack of emeralds.
Whether cartographers offer Spice Map trades. Only affects newly generated offers.
Spice Map price multiplier for common Spices.
Spice Map price multiplier for epic Spices. Cartographers don't sell these by default, but datapacks and other mods may.
Spice Map price multiplier for rare Spices.
Per-tier scaling of the Spice Map base price.
Spice Map price multiplier for uncommon Spices.
Spice Map offers sold by cartographer villagers.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMap.villag: Maximum distance, in Spice Regions, a cartographer searches for a Spice Region's heart when offering a Spice Map. Lower values keep trading halls from reaching every Spice.
spice_road.configuration.title.tooltip: Configure how Spices generate, grow, trade and taste.
spice_road.configuration.title: The Spice Road
spice_road.configuration.tooltip.alwaysS: Always show tooltip content that normally requires holding Shift.
spice_road.configuration.tooltip.showAxi: Show each Flavor Axis' value after its label (e.g. [Spicy: -0.5]).
spice_road.configuration.tooltip.showBot: Show both labels of each Flavor Axis (e.g. [Spicy / Cooling]), emphasizing the one matching the value.
spice_road.configuration.tooltip.tooltip: What this mod shows on item tooltips.
spice_road.configuration.tree.fruitingLe: Share of a common Spice Tree's leaves that can bear fruit.
Share of an epic Spice Tree's leaves that can bear fruit.
Share of a rare Spice Tree's leaves that can bear fruit.
Per-tier share of a Spice Tree's air-exposed, naturally grown leaves that can bear fruit.
Share of an uncommon Spice Tree's leaves that can bear fruit.
spice_road.configuration.tree.harvestYie: Harvest yield multiplier for Spice Trees, applied when stripping bark or picking fruiting leaves. Fractional results are rounded up or down at random.
spice_road.configuration.tree.tooltip: Harvesting Spices that grow on trees.
spice_road.configuration.vine.ripeningSe: Share of a common Spice Vine's segments that can ripen.
Share of an epic Spice Vine's segments that can ripen.
Share of a rare Spice Vine's segments that can ripen.
Per-tier share of a Spice Vine's segments that can ripen.
Share of an uncommon Spice Vine's segments that can ripen.
